directory: Put every file in one directory, keeping each file's folder, and give the page its address with `plugins`. The reader and the full editor read the same directory; `builds` says which use a plug-in.

plugins.name: flowchart
plugins.adds: Draws Mermaid flowcharts and graphs natively, in the editor's own style.

plugins.name: docx
plugins.adds: Opens a Word document (.docx) as a Markdown document: headings, lists, tables, pictures and comments.

plugins.name: math
plugins.adds: Typesets TeX math ($...$ and $$...$$) as SVG.

plugins.name: diagrams
plugins.adds: Draws every other Mermaid diagram: sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt, pie and more.

plugins.name: pdf
plugins.adds: Opens a PDF as a Markdown document: its text layer, or each page as a picture. Fetches the pdf.js files itself.

plugins.name: ocr
plugins.adds: Reads the words in pictures on the device (PP-OCRv6 tiny on ONNX Runtime Web), so search finds them. About 21 MB.

plugins.name: font-subset
plugins.adds: Keeps the used characters in fonts embedded in exported pages.

plugins.name: letters
plugins.adds: Draw's ornamental letter sets: Field, Relief, Leaf, Arabesque, Silhouette, Gothic, Sugar, Illuminated 1490, Tuscan 1845, Renaissance alphabet.

plugins.name: templates
plugins.adds: Starters' traced page borders: 72 borders from the ornament book.

plugins.name: elements
plugins.adds: The Elements sheet's traced ornaments: 3,257 pieces from the ornament book.

plugins.name: lettersets
plugins.adds: The Gallery's letter sets: 31 sets of ornamental capitals.
